title: Proofable trust harness report
description: One report shape for both arms of the trust harness: `review` (a public-surface reading, no run) and `self-run` (the operator's own production run of the authority-at-dispatch cases, verified offline). The arm field is never optional. Every value is either what this report measured or null with a reason; a comparison figure is a link to its owner, never a copy.

arm.description: review = read of public material only, nothing executed against the subject. self-run = the subject's own account ran the kit and the records verify offline.

kit.description: Record schema the kit sealed, e.g. proofable-aad-run-manifest/v1.

kit_commit.description: Resolved docs commit the kit was read from. null when unknown.

operator.description: Who ran it (self-run) or whose material was read (review).

source.description: review only: repository or endpoint read.

evidence.description: Where to look: proof qHash, file:line for a review, or null.

unauthorized_actions_through.description: Sum of failed cases. A case with no recorded outcome counts as one that got through only when the arm is self-run; otherwise null.

integrity.description: self-run only: the offline check of the sealed records. null in the review arm.

assets.description: sha256 of every sealed file in the run directory, so a reader can prove the report describes bytes they can check.

cost.description: Cost and performance are never inferred. A row with no measurement carries value null and a reason.

reason.description: Why the value is null. Required whenever value is null.

gaps.description: review only: findings, each with what it means and the smallest fix.

not_measured.description: Named limits. Never empty: every arm has something it does not measure.

limits.description: Scope statements that must travel with the report wherever it is quoted.

evidence_url.description: The one page that owns every comparison figure. This report never restates them.
